{"edits": [{"finding_ids": ["app/profiles.py:8:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:9:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:10:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:15:test-failure"], "search": "    bio: Optional[str]
    website: Optional[str]
    age: Optional[int]", "replace": "    bio: Optional[str] = None
    website: Optional[str] = None
    age: Optional[int] = None", "explanation": "In Pydantic v2, a field annotated Optional[T] with no default is required (the v1 implicit default of None was removed; see the v2 migration guide, 'Required, optional, and nullable fields'). Adding `= None` restores the v1 behavior. This also fixes test_blank_fields_become_none: profile_from_form drops blank/None form values, so bio, website and age are omitted from the kwargs and now default to None instead of raising 'Field required'."}], "notes": "Single edit covers lines 8-10 (adjacent, non-overlapping). The test-failure finding (line 15) is resolved by the same change, since profile_from_form omits blank fields and they now default to None; no change to profile_from_form is needed. The `interests: List[str] = []` line already has a default and is left alone, as is the mutable-default pattern, which Pydantic v2 copies per instance. No deprecated v1 APIs appear in this file, so no import changes are needed; Optional and List are still used."}
